text: Free horror demo on Steam. You get sixty seconds to escape a basement.
And this is Mr HappyFunFace. Don't look at him.
The keys hide somewhere new every run. So you die, learn the maze, and run it faster.
The trailer is all heavy breathing, pitch-black corridors and slammed doors. It looks properly stressful.
The catch? When the lights do come on, the walls look a bit basic.
The full game is already out, and eleven of its twelve Steam reviews are positive.
And the file list hides a whole Chromium web browser. A hundred and forty-six megabytes, in a horror game.
Worth a dip if you can keep your eyes on the floor.
